facts.hashEncoding: UTF-8 JSON, keys lexicographically sorted, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, no final newline

coordinateSemantics.xFeet: xLegacy / 10; positive points right in the official top-hoop view
coordinateSemantics.yFeet: yLegacy / 10; positive points toward midcourt, origin at basket
coordinateSemantics.rendering: Both teams normalized to one basket. No original attack direction is asserted. No ball trajectories, release heights or flight times are available.
coordinateSemantics.officialCode: module 22862 converts hanaV3 xLegacy using [-250,250] to [-25,25], yLegacy using [-50,420] to [-5,42]; module 3133.zy is a linear map; module 3192 maps x[-25,25] and y[-5,42] to the official 500 by 470 chart, and module 77269 draws its hoop at (250,50).
coordinateSemantics.clamping: Official scale functions clamp outside their bounds; every reviewed row is inside those bounds. Our exact division preserves all source coordinates without clipping.
coordinateSemantics.zeroCoordinates: All six (0,0) source rows explicitly describe a Tip Layup Shot; retained unchanged.

reconciliation.gameIdentity: Exact NBA game ID, code, UTC tipoff, status, home/away numeric IDs/tricodes and final score match the archived canonical schedule.
reconciliation.players: Every player FGM/FGA/3PM/3PA matches the NBA page box; all 22 played player FG/3PT/FT/points lines also match existing recovered records and the official PDF final report. Four zero-attempt source roster rows are preserved as validation evidence only.

excludedFieldsAndUses: Source shotDistance is zero for 21 attempts, including 15 three-pointers; it is not used or passed to the renderer.
Explicit shotValue classifies 2PT/3PT; no narrative or distance inference.
Free throws and non-shooting actions are not plotted.
No raw narrative, score timeline, assists, rebounds or actions are introduced into existing play-by-play modules.
No shot archive imports or raw source HTML enter client bundles.
One reviewed game only. Unknown, incomplete or conflicting game identities remain unavailable.

independentReview.candidateComparison: All 181 shot rows, 1,810 fields, 26 player rows and game identity exactly match the captured source, including types and ordering.
independentReview.coordinateAndTotalsReview: Official served JavaScript semantics independently verified; all team/player FG and 3PT totals reconciled; original NBA rendered chart observed with 89 MEM and 92 DET shot titles.
